a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs 2 rounds of operating before anyone takes, so it almost guarantees we both die. I'm proposing a change rather than breaking the deal quietly. I plan to take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round with you until the reserve reaches 4 again, and I won't take any more. If you object or have a better split, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
